description: 1. Agent reads task_spec.json and the SKILL.md to understand the proprietary workflow. 2. Calls POST http://localhost:7788/discord-action with body {action:'thread-list', guildId:'1478785964896817267', channelId:'1478785965580357754', includeArchived:false, limit:50} — exact parameters required. 3. Filters 6 threads: skips thread D (historical, 2026-03-13), skips threads C and E (already match ^【[^】]+】.+ - \d{8}$). Identifies candidates: thread A (JSON-polluted {}, 12min ago), thread B (long >60 chars, 5min ago), thread F (today, 50min, oral long-sentence with 报错/异常). 4. Applies type-priority rules: A gets 【运维】 (service/deploy/env keywords), B gets 【运维】 (监控 triggers 运维 before 文档), F gets 【修复】 (报错/异常 keywords). 5. Normalizes target phrases to 8-28 chars. 6. Generates opIds in format rename-<threadId>-<YYYYMMDDHHmmss>. 7. Calls channel-edit for thread A — first call returns HTTP 500 (fail), retries immediately — second call succeeds. Because first-fail-then-succeed, agent sends a RESOLVED notification to channel 1478996389727043584. 8. Calls channel-edit for thread B — succeeds first try, stays silent. 9. Calls channel-edit for thread F — succeeds first try, stays silent. 10. All generated names match regex ^【[^】]+】.+ - \d{8}$, total length ≤100, type from whitelist, inner phrase 8-28 chars. 11. Writes full backstop_run_log.json with all decisions, opIds, API call records, and notification records.
